name: What Comes Next
summary: The High Order seeks your blessing before leaving Zephras Isle with its Kirin Tor allies. Its expedition depends on finding an arcane answer to the island’s instability.

sections.title: The Departure
sections.body: High Elder Shadowsong has blessed the expedition, and preparations are ready. Ansirem has worked to establish skycutter travel between Dalaran and Zephras Isle. The vanguard is preparing to depart, and you can speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are ready to leave the island.

faq.q: Who do I speak with before leaving Zephras Isle?
faq.answer: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are ready to leave Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Where is the High Order going?
faq.answer: The High Order is preparing an expedition, with skycutter transport linking Dalaran and Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Who is helping the High Order?
faq.answer: The Kirin Tor are helping the High Order, and Ansirem has worked on skycutter transport between Dalaran and Zephras Isle.
The expedition hopes to find an arcane solution that can bring stability to Zephras Isle.
Elaadrin says the cult has been defeated, and preparations for the expedition are complete.

attribution: In-game quest text: What Comes Next
